data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Adaha means 'God's Adornment'. This name was borne by a woman in the Old Testament who offered herself as a sacrifice to God in place of her husband, Abel. The name Adaha carries the meaning “God's Adornment” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Adaha usually hope their child will grow to embody god's adornment and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To be adorned by the divine.
data.etymology: Adaha belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Adornment.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Adaha total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
